name: agent-world
description: Explore a sci-fi outpost, meet your saved Locus agents, and give them real work.

interface.shortDescription: A world for your agents in Locus.
interface.longDescription: Oversee a living garden outpost where free agents explore and working agents return to their stations. Click characters connected to your saved profiles to chat, assign tasks, and follow progress in a separate Locus window. Includes diverse animated residents and prepared Meshy scenery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Agent World in Locus to meet my saved agents.
